# Allan & Anne Shirley

- [Allan](../character/allan.md) — Friend of — [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — minister's wife and trusted confidante · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P24](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P8](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. ## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) bids farewell to Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) on the last day of school and later shares her excitement about the new minister, Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and his wife. After preparing extensively for the [Allans](../character/allan.md) to come to tea at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) bakes a special layer cake, but Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) notice something strangely wrong with it upon tasting it.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P15](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P34](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P36](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0036)_

> During tea with the minister and his wife, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally serves a cake flavored with liniment instead of vanilla. Mortified by her mistake, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) flees to her room in tears, but Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) kindly comforts her and assures her it was an honest mistake.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P35](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P50](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0050)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends re-enact [Elaine](../character/elaine.md) on a leaky flat boat, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stranded on a bridge pile when the boat sinks. [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) rescues her in a dory, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) coldly rejects his attempt to apologize and become friends. Back home, after discussing the day's lesson on avoiding over-romanticism with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) quietly encourages [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to keep a little romance.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P18](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P33](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0033)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) completes her [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) and returns to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to anxiously await the results. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) brings news that the pass list is out and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has tied for first place on the Island with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares her joyful success with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), concluding the evening with a peaceful visit to Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P25](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0025), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P38](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P40](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P44](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0044)_

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) collapses and dies suddenly after reading news of the bank failure. The household and community mourn his death, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) express their deep love for each other in their shared grief. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) talks with Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about coping with sorrow and moving forward.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P20](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0020)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finishes the school year and walks toward the cemetery, joining [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) along the way as they discuss family, grief, and imagination. After placing flowers on Matthew's and Hester Gray's graves, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) meets Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and the two walk home together chatting about ideals, teaching mistakes, studies with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and the true meaning of friendship.
>
> — v2 · XV The Beginning of Vacation

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) excitedly prepare [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and cook a feast to entertain Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md), but a series of mishaps occurs, including [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) ruining the lemon pies and accidentally knocking a heavy conch shell onto Miss Barry's borrowed platter. Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) fails to arrive, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) heartbroken until a letter reveals Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) sprained her ankle.
>
> — v2 · XVII A Chapter of Accidents

_Sources: [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P10](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0010), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P57](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0057), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P62](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0062)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) help Miss Lavendar and Charlotta the Fourth prepare for Miss Lavendar's wedding at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). The ceremony goes wonderfully as the sun breaks through the clouds, and the guests see off the newlyweds. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) waits with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) at the quiet house, where a moment of realization sparks a shift in how she perceives [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and her own maturity.
>
